---
title: "Explore the Data"
---

Explore the conditionality index for the 28 Conditional Cash Transfer programs in the CONDLA dataset (336 program-country-year observations, 1997-2026). Pick countries and a year range, then view the index as bars (for the end year of the range) or as a line chart over time.

Some observations have no computable conditionality value (a component is missing in the primary sources): those rows are excluded from the charts rather than plotted as 0, so as not to confuse "no data" with "no conditionality". See [Codebook & Methodology](codebook.qmd) for details.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/condla_indices.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
clean = data.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  ano: +d.ano,
  conditionality: d.conditionality === "NA" ? null : +d.conditionality,
  behaviour_ind: d.behaviour_ind === "NA" ? null : +d.behaviour_ind,
  monitoring_ind: d.monitoring_ind === "NA" ? null : +d.monitoring_ind,
  sanctions_ind: d.sanctions_ind === "NA" ? null : +d.sanctions_ind
}))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
paises = [...new Set(clean.map(d => d.pais))].sort()
anoMin = d3.min(clean, d => d.ano)
anoMax = d3.max(clean, d => d.ano)
```

<details open>
<summary><strong>Filters</strong></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof paisesSeleccionados = Inputs.checkbox(paises, {label: "Country", value: paises})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof anoDesde = Inputs.range([anoMin, anoMax], {label: "From", step: 1, value: anoMin})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof anoHasta = Inputs.range([anoMin, anoMax], {label: "To", step: 1, value: anoMax})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
rangoAnos = [Math.min(anoDesde, anoHasta), Math.max(anoDesde, anoHasta)]
```

</details>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filtered = clean.filter(d =>
  paisesSeleccionados.includes(d.pais) &&
  d.ano >= rangoAnos[0] && d.ano <= rangoAnos[1]
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
snapshot = clean.filter(d =>
  paisesSeleccionados.includes(d.pais) &&
  d.ano === rangoAnos[1] &&
  d.conditionality !== null
)
```

<details open>
<summary><strong>Chart</strong></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof chartType = Inputs.select(["Bars", "Lines"], {label: "View as", value: "Bars"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
chartType === "Bars"
  ? (snapshot.length === 0
      ? html`<p><em>No data for this filter.</em></p>`
      : Plot.plot({
          marginBottom: 90,
          width: 800,
          x: {label: null, tickRotate: -40},
          y: {label: "Conditionality index (0-1)", domain: [0, 1]},
          marks: [
            Plot.barY(snapshot, {x: "pais", y: "conditionality", fill: "#1B3B6F", sort: {x: "y"}}),
            Plot.ruleY([0])
          ]
        }))
  : (filtered.filter(d => d.conditionality !== null).length === 0
      ? html`<p><em>No data for this filter.</em></p>`
      : Plot.plot({
          width: 800,
          y: {label: "Conditionality index (0-1)", domain: [0, 1]},
          x: {label: "Year", tickFormat: "d"},
          color: {legend: true},
          marks: [
            Plot.line(filtered.filter(d => d.conditionality !== null), {x: "ano", y: "conditionality", stroke: "pais"}),
            Plot.ruleY([0])
          ]
        }))
```

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Data table</strong></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filtered.length === 0
  ? html`<p><em>No data for this filter.</em></p>`
  : Inputs.table(filtered, {
      columns: ["pais", "programa", "ano", "conditionality", "behaviour_ind", "monitoring_ind", "sanctions_ind"],
      header: {
        pais: "Country",
        programa: "Program",
        ano: "Year",
        conditionality: "Conditionality",
        behaviour_ind: "Behavior",
        monitoring_ind: "Monitoring",
        sanctions_ind: "Sanctions"
      },
      format: {ano: d => String(d)}
    })
```

</details>
